text: Item 3 scope decision: substantive pieces done now — crossnobis() documented and tested as the named Mahalanobis reading of contrast()$total on the same plan (decomposition available from contrast(), no class divergence); coupling() gives the adjoint closure one plan vocabulary. Pure renames deferred to a single 0.2 surface pass with this map: effect_frame(spatial)/measurement_frame(legs)/edge_frame(edge set) need three distinct nouns; geometry_alignment -> coupling_alignment; connectivity(view=) absorbs canonical_coupling/covariance_coupling/geometry_alignment/effect_coupling as views; the evidence pairing gets its public noun via the package-level doc topic first (Phase 4) so the vocabulary exists before exports move. Rationale: live renames late in this session would churn the certified frozen-vocabulary test and the shared board's open usability beads (bd-01KZYBK4TPEQZ95V1TKG5WKC0N names the same problem); one deliberate pass beats piecemeal aliasing.
